name: Cloud 80
notes: Domain-warped cloud: a soft cumulus spectrum resampled through low-frequency displacement - advected billows with silky streaming edges. Dual-gate architecture (docs/fractal-texture-math.md par.9): the mask multiplies the finished stroke once, so its structure survives the paint train; canvas-anchored delivery was considered for the damage textures and rejected in review in favour of dual-gating everything. Tips synthesized and calibrated from tips/cloud.spec.json (levels 30/55/80 = core-band stroke coverage); spectral verification by tools/spectrum-audit.mjs. Overcast with breaks. REVISED to a TONAL mask on a deep, fully scattered train: the mask is the tone-mapped field itself rather than a threshold cut, and the level is the modulation DEPTH. Dual spacing 0.33 -> 0.07 (n=12 overlap) with scatter kept at 0.7 - a Gaussian field averages to the same field, so this one can spend the overlap that buys the scatter, where a faceted texture could not (docs/fractal-texture-math.md §6). Ripple 9-11% -> 1.8-3.5%, comb 18-24% -> 1.1-4.2%.
